d:
Patna ke didarganj men punpun nadi ke ghat par bara hadsa, gahre pani men tin yuvak dube , talas jari
Patna ke didarganj thana kshetr sthit mirjapur ghat par punpun nadi men chhath mahaparv ke din char yuvak dubne lage .sthaniy logon ki madad se ek yuvak ko surakshit bacha liya gaya hai, jabki lapta tin any yuvkon ki talash ke lie sthanie log milkar opreshan chala rahe hain.bataya jarha hai ki chhath mahaparv ke dauran arghy dene pahunche tin yuvak gahre pani men jane ke karan dub gae. is apratyashit ghatna se ghat par aphrataphri mach gaee aur vahan maujud logon men kohram mach gaya.
